description_en: Queries the statistics on the number of security alerts in one or more asset groups
description_zh: 查询一个或多个资产分组下的安全告警数量统计值
name: GetSuspiciousStatistics

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the asset groups that you want to query. Separate multiple asset group IDs with commas (,).
> You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产分组ID。多个资产分组ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id_list

v1_parameters.help_en:

v1_parameters.name: GroupIdList
